283936223.description:
Mineral Specimen Lot - 8 Pieces
Agate, Petrified Wood, Calcite & Quartz Geodes
Natural Mineral Collection
A diverse 8-piece collection of natural mineral and geological display specimens featuring various formations, textures, and crystal structures. The assemblage includes polished cut display stones alongside hollow crystalline geode nodules, highlighting classic lapidary and natural rough presentations.
Items Included:
Polished Agate Half: Cut and face-polished specimen displaying concentric fortification banding in caramel and cream with a crystalline quartz core
Petrified Wood Block: Substantial cut specimen exhibiting rich reddish-brown, yellow, and amber banded grain patterns with raw textured backing
Calcite Cleavage Rhomb Specimen: Translucent block featuring prominent natural rhombohedral cleavage planes and matrix remnants
Quartz Geode Halves (5 pieces): Hollow natural geodes featuring interiors lined with sparkling crystalline quartz druzy cavities
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in sound structural condition. Polished faces on the agate and petrified wood show smooth finishes with minor handling contact. Rough matrix surfaces, natural fissures, crystal cavity inclusions, and cleavage breaks are inherent to the natural stone formation.
Any electronic items or components have only been tested for power and are not eligible for returns based on functionality. All of our testing notes will be included in the listing details, if no notes are provided, item was unable to be tested.
